``` {r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Environment and Global Configuration
# ==============================================================================

# Ensure required packages are installed and loaded
if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
if(!require("here")) install.packages("here")
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, reticulate, readr, stringr, here, fs)

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Experiment Version Control (SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Options: "E1" (Sequential Presentation) or "E2" (Simultaneous Presentation)
# This toggle controls BOTH the output directory sandboxing AND the 
# component time-window definitions (e.g., FRN latency shifts, N170 inclusion).
experiment_version <- "E1" 

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Method Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------
# TRUE  = Standard Method: Subtracts baseline mean from the epoch.
# FALSE = Regression Method: No baseline subtraction (extracts baseline as covariate).
use_baseline_correction <- TRUE

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Baseline Parameters (Stimulus-Locked Only)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
use_full_prestim_baseline <- FALSE

# Construct the baseline argument for MNE-Python.
baseline_arg <- NULL
if (use_baseline_correction) {
  if (use_full_prestim_baseline) {
    # Baseline: Start of epoch to 0ms
    baseline_arg <- list(NULL, 0.0) 
  } else {
    # Baseline: -200ms to 0ms
    baseline_arg <- c(-0.2, 0.0)    
  }
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Phase Control (Pipeline Stages)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
run_offer_phase <- TRUE   # Stimulus-Locked 
run_cpp_phase   <- FALSE  # Response-Locked (CPP)

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Path Definitions (Hierarchical & Dynamic)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
path_py_pipeline_src <- here("python_modules", "hu-neuro-pipeline")

# Raw input paths are versioned by experiment_version so that E1 and E2 data
# can coexist on disk without manual relocation. Expected layout:
#   data/00_Raw_Input/raw_all_cropped_E1/   data/00_Raw_Input/csv_all_E1/
#   data/00_Raw_Input/raw_all_cropped_E2/   data/00_Raw_Input/csv_all_E2/
# Toggle experiment_version above to switch which dataset is processed.
path_raw_eeg         <- here("data", "00_Raw_Input", paste0("raw_all_cropped_", experiment_version))
path_raw_log         <- here("data", "00_Raw_Input", paste0("csv_all_", experiment_version))

# Dynamic Sandboxing based on experiment_version
path_csv_filtered    <- here("data", paste0("01_Preprocessing_Logs_", experiment_version), "csv_filtered")
path_csv_summary     <- here("data", paste0("01_Preprocessing_Logs_", experiment_version), "csv_summary")
path_output_root     <- here("data", paste0("02_Pipeline_Output_", experiment_version))

if (use_baseline_correction) {
  path_suffix <- "Standard_Baseline"
  method_folder <- "Method_Standard"
} else {
  path_suffix <- "No_Baseline"
  method_folder <- "Method_Regression"
}

dir_stim_name  <- "Stimulus_Locked"    
dir_cpp_name   <- "Response_Locked"

path_dest_stim       <- file.path(path_output_root, method_folder, dir_stim_name)
path_dest_cpp        <- file.path(path_output_root, method_folder, dir_cpp_name)
path_dest_covariates <- file.path(path_output_root, "Covariates")
path_dest_baseline   <- file.path(path_output_root, "Baseline_Raw") 

path_dest_report_stim <- file.path(path_dest_stim, "report")
path_dest_report_cpp  <- file.path(path_dest_cpp, "report")

dirs_to_create <- c(
  path_csv_filtered, path_csv_summary, path_output_root,
  path_dest_stim, path_dest_cpp, path_dest_covariates,
  path_dest_baseline, path_dest_report_stim, path_dest_report_cpp
)
purrr::walk(dirs_to_create, ~dir.create(., showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE))

# Defensive check: raw-input directories must exist for the selected
# experiment_version. Failing fast here gives a clear error message; without
# this, downstream code would fail later in obscure ways (empty file lists,
# zero-row data frames, MNE-Python errors).
if (!dir.exists(path_raw_eeg)) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "Raw EEG directory not found for experiment_version='%s':\n  %s\nExpected layout: data/00_Raw_Input/raw_all_cropped_%s/",
    experiment_version, path_raw_eeg, experiment_version
  ))
}
if (!dir.exists(path_raw_log)) {
  stop(sprintf(
    "Raw log directory not found for experiment_version='%s':\n  %s\nExpected layout: data/00_Raw_Input/csv_all_%s/",
    experiment_version, path_raw_log, experiment_version
  ))
}


```

# 2. Python Environment Initialization

```{r Environment, include=FALSE}
use_condaenv("r-reticulate", required = TRUE)
py_pipeline_path <- path_py_pipeline_src

py_run_string("
import sys
import os
import importlib

local_path = r.py_pipeline_path
if os.path.exists(local_path):
    if local_path not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, local_path)

try:
    import pipeline
    importlib.reload(pipeline)
except ImportError as e:
    print(f'Error: Could not import pipeline. {e}')
")

pipeline_mod <- import("pipeline")

```

# 3. Log Preprocessing

```{r log-preprocessing}
orig_logs <- list.files(path_raw_log, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
cat("Processing", length(orig_logs), "log files for Experiment:", experiment_version, "\n")

for (fpath in orig_logs) {
  fb  <- file(fpath, "rb")
  bom <- readBin(fb, "raw", n = 2)
  close(fb)
  encoding <- if (length(bom) == 2 && identical(bom, as.raw(c(0xFF, 0xFE)))) "UTF-16LE" else "UTF-8"

  df <- read_delim(fpath, delim = "\t", col_types = cols(), show_col_types = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = encoding))
  n <- nrow(df)

  df_trials <- df %>% 
    slice(1:(n-3)) %>% filter(block != 7) %>% 
    mutate(emotion = str_extract(stim, "enj|dis|dom|neu|aff"))
  
  df_summary <- df %>% slice((n-2):n)

  out_name <- paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fpath)), ".csv")
  out_name_summary <- paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(fpath)), "_summaryPostRating.csv")
    
  write_csv(df_trials, file.path(path_csv_filtered, out_name))
  write_csv(df_summary, file.path(path_dest_covariates, out_name_summary))
}
cat("Log preprocessing complete.\n")

```

# 4. Condition Definitions

```{r define-conditions}
# ==============================================================================
# Experimental Design & Condition Pooling Specifications
# ==============================================================================
# Fair categorization: Offers 5:5 and 6:4
# Unfair categorization: Offers 8:2 and 9:1
# Note: Offer 7:3 serves as a filler condition and is excluded from the pooled 
#       fairness contrasts to maximize signal-to-noise ratio.
# General Inclusion Criteria: Valid reaction (>0), RT between 300 and 3000 ms.

common_average_by <- list(
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # A. Raw Cell Conditions (5 Emotions x 5 Offers)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Face_enj_5_5 = "emotion=='enj' & Offers_Other==5 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dis_5_5 = "emotion=='dis' & Offers_Other==5 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dom_5_5 = "emotion=='dom' & Offers_Other==5 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_neu_5_5 = "emotion=='neu' & Offers_Other==5 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_aff_5_5 = "emotion=='aff' & Offers_Other==5 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    
    Face_enj_6_4 = "emotion=='enj' & Offers_Other==6 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dis_6_4 = "emotion=='dis' & Offers_Other==6 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dom_6_4 = "emotion=='dom' & Offers_Other==6 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_neu_6_4 = "emotion=='neu' & Offers_Other==6 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_aff_6_4 = "emotion=='aff' & Offers_Other==6 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    
    Face_enj_7_3 = "emotion=='enj' & Offers_Other==7 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dis_7_3 = "emotion=='dis' & Offers_Other==7 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dom_7_3 = "emotion=='dom' & Offers_Other==7 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_neu_7_3 = "emotion=='neu' & Offers_Other==7 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_aff_7_3 = "emotion=='aff' & Offers_Other==7 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    
    Face_enj_8_2 = "emotion=='enj' & Offers_Other==8 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dis_8_2 = "emotion=='dis' & Offers_Other==8 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dom_8_2 = "emotion=='dom' & Offers_Other==8 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_neu_8_2 = "emotion=='neu' & Offers_Other==8 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_aff_8_2 = "emotion=='aff' & Offers_Other==8 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    
    Face_enj_9_1 = "emotion=='enj' & Offers_Other==9 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dis_9_1 = "emotion=='dis' & Offers_Other==9 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dom_9_1 = "emotion=='dom' & Offers_Other==9 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_neu_9_1 = "emotion=='neu' & Offers_Other==9 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_aff_9_1 = "emotion=='aff' & Offers_Other==9 & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # B. Main Effect Pooling (Orthogonal Dimensions)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Grand_Fair   = "(emotion=='enj' | emotion=='dis' | emotion=='dom' | emotion=='neu' | emotion=='aff') & (Offers_Other==5 | Offers_Other==6) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Grand_Unfair = "(emotion=='enj' | emotion=='dis' | emotion=='dom' | emotion=='neu' | emotion=='aff') & (Offers_Other==8 | Offers_Other==9) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",

    All_Neu = "emotion=='neu' & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    All_Dis = "emotion=='dis' & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    All_Enj = "emotion=='enj' & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    All_Dom = "emotion=='dom' & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    All_Aff = "emotion=='aff' & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # C. Simple Effect Pooling (Emotion within Fairness Contexts)
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Face_dis_Unfair = "emotion=='dis' & (Offers_Other==8 | Offers_Other==9) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_neu_Unfair = "emotion=='neu' & (Offers_Other==8 | Offers_Other==9) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_enj_Unfair = "emotion=='enj' & (Offers_Other==8 | Offers_Other==9) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dom_Unfair = "emotion=='dom' & (Offers_Other==8 | Offers_Other==9) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_aff_Unfair = "emotion=='aff' & (Offers_Other==8 | Offers_Other==9) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",

    Face_dis_Fair = "emotion=='dis' & (Offers_Other==5 | Offers_Other==6) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_neu_Fair = "emotion=='neu' & (Offers_Other==5 | Offers_Other==6) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_enj_Fair = "emotion=='enj' & (Offers_Other==5 | Offers_Other==6) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_dom_Fair = "emotion=='dom' & (Offers_Other==5 | Offers_Other==6) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000",
    Face_aff_Fair = "emotion=='aff' & (Offers_Other==5 | Offers_Other==6) & reaction>0 & RT >= 300 & RT <= 3000"
)

copy_trials_csv <- function(src_dir, dest_dir, new_filename = "trials.csv") {
  src_trials <- file.path(src_dir, "trials.csv")
  if (file.exists(src_trials)) {
    file.copy(src_trials, file.path(dest_dir, new_filename), overwrite = TRUE)
  }
}

```

# 5. ERP Component Extraction and Statistical Testing

## 5.1 Stimulus-Locked Phase

```{r stimulus-locked-phase}
if (run_offer_phase) {

  out_stim <- path_dest_stim
  if (!dir.exists(out_stim)) dir.create(out_stim, recursive = TRUE)

  stim_raw_files <- list.files(path_raw_eeg, pattern = "\\.(set|vhdr)$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (length(stim_raw_files) == 0) stop("CRITICAL: No EEG files found.")

  cat(sprintf("\n=== Running Stimulus-Locked Extraction ===\n"))
  cat(sprintf("Experiment: %s\n", experiment_version))

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Component definitions (windows + ROIs) are read from the single source of
  # truth shared by all stats and visualization scripts:
  #   config/erp_components.csv  (t_min/t_max in SECONDS; roi pipe-delimited).
  # To change a window/ROI, or add/remove a component, edit ONLY that file.
  # Currently FRN and P3, identical for E1 and E2; windows/ROIs are data-driven
  # from a Cartool topographic segmentation of the Unfair-Fair difference wave.
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  comp_csv <- here("config", "erp_components.csv")
  if (!file.exists(comp_csv)) {
    stop(sprintf("Component config not found: %s", comp_csv))
  }
  comp_def <- readr::read_csv(comp_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
  required_cols <- c("experiment", "comp_name", "t_min", "t_max", "roi")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(comp_def))) {
    stop(sprintf("config/erp_components.csv must contain columns: %s",
                 paste(required_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  comp_def <- comp_def[comp_def$experiment == experiment_version, ]
  if (nrow(comp_def) == 0) {
    stop(sprintf("No component rows for experiment '%s' in config/erp_components.csv",
                 experiment_version))
  }
  erp_config <- tibble::tibble(
    comp_name    = comp_def$comp_name,
    t_min        = comp_def$t_min,
    t_max        = comp_def$t_max,
    roi_channels = strsplit(comp_def$roi, "|", fixed = TRUE)
  )

  if (!use_baseline_correction) {
    baseline_config <- erp_config %>%
      mutate(comp_name = paste0("Baseline_", comp_name), t_min = -0.200, t_max = 0.000)
    final_config <- bind_rows(erp_config, baseline_config)
  } else {
    final_config <- erp_config
  }

  components_arg <- list(
    name = as.list(final_config$comp_name),
    tmin = as.list(final_config$t_min),
    tmax = as.list(final_config$t_max),
    roi  = final_config$roi_channels
  )

# ==========================================================================
  # Refined Statistical Contrasts for Temporal Window Definition
  # ==========================================================================
  # Methodological Update: 
  # Replaced the original 13 exploratory contrasts with 2 strictly orthogonal
  # main effects. This prevents severe Family-Wise Error Rate (FWER) inflation 
  # during the mass-univariate permutation testing phase.
  # 
  # Purpose:
  # These contrasts serve as functional localizers to data-drive the temporal 
  # boundaries of the component overlap (e.g., isolating Face N170/EPN from Offer FRN).
  # Complex interaction testing is delegated to downstream Linear Mixed Models (LMM).
  
  perm_contrasts_list <- list(
    # 1. Isolate the Economic Fairness Effect (Expected: FRN, N400, LPP)
    # Collapses across all emotional faces to computationally cancel out 
    # visual and affective variance.
    c('Grand_Unfair', 'Grand_Fair'),
    
    # 2. Isolate the Facial Emotion Effect (Expected: N170, EPN)
    # Collapses across all economic offers to computationally cancel out 
    # fairness-related variance. 
    # Note: 'All_Dis' vs 'All_Neu' is selected as the primary functional 
    # localizer for negative valence processing.
    c('All_Dis', 'All_Neu')
  )

  # Proceed with the pipeline execution using the refined contrasts
  res_stim <- pipeline_mod$group_pipeline(
    raw_files        = stim_raw_files,   
    log_files        = path_csv_filtered,
    output_dir       = out_stim,     
    epochs_dir       = file.path(out_stim, "epochs"), 
    
    ica_method       = "fastica",
    ica_n_components = 0.99,
    triggers         = c(10:89, 150:169),
    bad_channels     = "auto",
    highpass_freq    = 0.05,
    lowpass_freq     = 30.0,
    reject_peak_to_peak = 200.0,
    baseline         = baseline_arg, 
    
    components       = components_arg, 
    average_by       = common_average_by,
    
    perm_contrasts   = perm_contrasts_list, # Updated list passed here
    perm_tmin        = 0.150,  
    perm_tmax        = 0.800,  
    perm_channels    = NULL    
  )
  
  if (!use_baseline_correction) {
      out_bl_archive <- file.path(path_dest_baseline, "Stimulus_Locked_Values")
      if(!dir.exists(out_bl_archive)) dir.create(out_bl_archive, recursive=TRUE)
      copy_trials_csv(out_stim, out_bl_archive, "baseline_values.csv")
  }
}

```

## 5.2 Response-Locked Phase (CPP)

```{r response-locked-phase}
if (run_cpp_phase) {

  out_cpp <- path_dest_cpp
  if (!dir.exists(out_cpp)) dir.create(out_cpp, recursive = TRUE)
  
  raw_files_found <- list.files(path_raw_eeg, pattern = "\\.(set|vhdr)$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  log_files_found <- list.files(path_csv_filtered, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(raw_files_found) == 0) stop("CRITICAL: No EEG files found for CPP.")
  
  cat(sprintf("\n=== Running Response-Locked Extraction (CPP) ===\n"))

  path_csv_cpp_aligned <- file.path(path_output_root, "01_Preprocessing_Logs", "csv_cpp_aligned")
  if (!dir.exists(path_csv_cpp_aligned)) dir.create(path_csv_cpp_aligned, recursive = TRUE)
  
  final_raw_list <- c()
  final_log_list <- c()
  log_ids <- as.integer(str_extract(basename(log_files_found), "\\d+"))
  
  for (raw_path in raw_files_found) {
    raw_fname <- basename(raw_path)
    eeg_id <- as.integer(str_extract(raw_fname, "\\d+"))
    match_idx <- which(log_ids == eeg_id)
    
    if (length(match_idx) == 1) {
      src_log <- log_files_found[match_idx]
      df_temp <- read_csv(src_log, show_col_types = FALSE)
      df_cpp <- df_temp %>% filter(reaction > 0)
      
      dest_fname <- paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(raw_fname), ".csv")
      dest_log   <- file.path(path_csv_cpp_aligned, dest_fname)
      write_csv(df_cpp, dest_log)
      
      final_raw_list <- c(final_raw_list, raw_path)
      final_log_list <- c(final_log_list, dest_log)
    }
  }

  roi_cpp <- c("Pz","Cz","C1","C2","CP1","CP2")
  cpp_components <- list(name = list("CPP"), tmin = list(-0.30), tmax = list(0.05), roi  = list(roi_cpp))
  
  py_raw_files <- as.list(final_raw_list)
  py_log_files <- as.list(final_log_list)

  res_cpp <- pipeline_mod$group_pipeline(
    raw_files        = py_raw_files,
    log_files        = py_log_files,
    output_dir       = out_cpp,
    epochs_dir       = file.path(out_cpp, "epochs"), 
    
    ica_method       = "fastica",
    ica_n_components = 0.99,
    triggers         = c(1, 2), 
    epochs_on_missing = 'ignore',        
    bad_channels     = "auto",
    highpass_freq    = 0.05,
    lowpass_freq     = 30.0,
    epochs_tmin      = -0.9,             
    epochs_tmax      = 0.5,
    baseline         = NULL, 
    reject_peak_to_peak = 200.0,
    components       = cpp_components,
    average_by       = common_average_by
  )

  copy_trials_csv(out_cpp, path_dest_cpp)
}

```
